MIMImageAcquisition.instrument.description: Microscope hardware configuration used during image acquisition.

MIMImageAcquisition.modified_on.description: Date and time when the metadata record was last modified.

MIMImageAcquisition.time_interval.description: Optional interval between sequential timepoints for time-lapse acquisition.

MIMImageData.channels.description: Ordered channel descriptions corresponding to the encoded channel dimension.

MIMImageData.created_on.description: Date and time when the metadata record was created.

MIMImageData.modified_on.description: Date and time when the metadata record was last modified.

MIMImageData.size_c.description: Number of encoded image channels, including a transmission channel when present.

MIMImageData.size_t.description: Number of timepoints; use 1 for a non-time-lapse acquisition.

MIMImageData.size_x.description: Number of pixels along the X axis.

MIMImageData.size_y.description: Number of pixels along the Y axis.

MIMImageData.size_z.description: Number of Z planes; use 1 for a single plane.

MIMImagingChannel.channel_index.description: Sequential 1-based channel order identifier in the image stack.

MIMImagingChannel.channel_label.description: Short human- and pipeline-readable label assigned to the channel (e.g., Nuclei, CHOP-GFP, PI, AnV).

MIMImagingChannel.emission_wavelength.description: Emission wavelength or filter center with unit (e.g., 525 nm).

MIMImagingChannel.excitation_wavelength.description: Excitation wavelength setting with unit (e.g., 488 nm).

MIMImagingChannel.exposure_time.description: Detector exposure duration for this channel with unit (e.g., 100 ms).

MIMImagingChannel.is_transmission_channe.description: Flag indicating whether this channel captures transmitted/bright-field light rather than fluorescence.

MIMImagingChannel.visualization_method.description: FBbi ontology term describing the visualization or staining method (e.g., Hoechst 33342, EGFP, mCherryFP, propidium iodide).

MIMImagingChannel.visualized_entity.description: Biological structure, macromolecule, or gene/protein visualized in this channel (e.g., DNA, DDIT3, LMNA, TNFAIP3).

MIMImagingChannel.visualized_entity_refe.description: Optional external identifier (e.g., HGNC, Ensembl, UniProt, GO) for the visualized biological entity.

MIMImagingInstrument.detector_type.description: Detector or camera sensor type (e.g., sCMOS, CCD, PMT, GaAsP).

MIMImagingInstrument.immersion_medium.description: Optical immersion medium used with the objective lens (e.g., air, water, immersion oil).

MIMImagingInstrument.micrometa_reference.description: Resolvable reference to a Micro-Meta App hardware configuration file or instrument record.

MIMImagingInstrument.microscope_type.description: Ontology term (e.g., FBbi) describing the microscope modality (e.g., confocal microscope, widefield microscope).

MIMImagingInstrument.objective_magnifica.description: Nominal magnification of the objective lens (e.g., 10, 20, 40, 63).

MIMImagingInstrument.objective_numerical.description: Numerical aperture (NA) of the objective lens.

MIMWell.well_role.description: Experimental role of the well (e.g., sample, positive control, negative control, vehicle control, blank).
